situation.initiating: a sequence is under way and the actor has decided not to finish it — not because they misunderstood the agent, which would be repair, and not because the goal is met, which would be closing; the sequence is unwanted or going wrong, and what's needed is a way out that isn't a failure

resulting.clause: the sequence is halted where it stood, the actor has been told what if anything changed, and the exchange is back at a point where they can start something else or leave
whatever the sequence collected is now a loose end — a part-filled draft, a half-applied change — and the actor has to be able to see it to decide whether it stays

situation.initiating: what's worth the actor's attention arrives from many sources on nobody's schedule, and checking each one costs time proportional to the number of sources rather than to how much actually happened

resulting.clause: updates from everywhere arrive in one scannable flow, so noticing what changed costs one look instead of several rounds
the ordering is a claim about what matters: chronological is predictable and treats everything as equal, algorithmic is relevant and unaccountable
a feed has no end, so there is no state in which the actor is finished with it — which is both why it sustains attention and why it is hard to put down

situation.initiating: things happened across actors and time that somebody now has to reconstruct — who did what, when, in what order — and the current state of the system shows the outcome with none of the path to it

resulting.clause: the path is recoverable: discrete events read as a reviewable history, each with an actor, an action, an object and a time attached
the record is what accountability now rests on, which makes what it leaves out as consequential as what it holds
histories only grow, so the log is useful in proportion to how narrowable it is — a complete record nobody can read is the same as no record

situation.initiating: no exchange is under way and the agent has a reason to start one — work to propose, a change to report — so footing has to be established before any activity can begin: who is speaking, what it can do, and what this is about

resulting.clause: footing is set and a topic is on the table; the encounter is at its first fork, and a topic the actor accepts on any scale beyond a single question opens into an open request
the actor has been addressed but has committed to nothing; if they turn down the proposed topic and offer nothing in its place, the encounter needs an exit before it reaches any activity

situation.initiating: an activity is under way and the agent's own understanding has broken — ambiguity, low confidence, several candidate entities, a required value absent — so acting on the current reading risks doing the wrong thing confidently

resulting.clause: the agent's reading of the request is on the surface where the actor can correct it; where the trouble turns out to be one specific missing value rather than a wrong interpretation, the exchange narrows to asking for it
understanding is restored and the primary activity resumes at the step it broke on rather than from the beginning, on its way to the receipt that closes the sequence

situation.initiating: the actor can state a goal but not a procedure — the steps aren't known in advance, or there are too many of them to walk through by hand — and the system holds capabilities they would otherwise have to assemble themselves

resulting.clause: there is a standing intermediary between intent and capability: the actor says what they want and something else decides how, which is both the whole benefit and the whole exposure

how much freedom the agent has to act unprompted is a setting rather than a fixed property, so the actor's trust has to be calibrated to whatever it currently is — and they have to be able to find that out
the work happened somewhere the actor wasn't watching, so it owes an account of itself afterwards to be reviewable at all
inline generation makes accepting cheaper than evaluating, so over-reliance accrues by default — deliberate friction is the countermove

situation.initiating: the agent's default behaviour is close but not right, and the mismatch keeps recurring; correcting it turn by turn is work the actor repeats forever, so what they need is to change the standing behaviour rather than this instance of it

resulting.clause: the standing behaviour is the actor's to shape, so a correction made once holds across sessions instead of being re-issued each time
how far the system may act on its own is now something the actor set, which moves the responsibility for that boundary onto them
tuning accumulates and then goes quiet: behaviour configured months ago reads later as simply how the system is, including to the actor who configured it

situation.initiating: the content is fixed and not the actor's to change — someone else's document, a published record, a source that has to stay as it is — but their reading of it needs somewhere to live; without a layer over the top, interpretation either alters the original or stays in the actor's head

resulting.clause: the actor's interpretation sits over the content without touching it, and the marks accumulate as wear — traces of where attention and effort actually went, readable long after
once the marks are visible to others the layer stops being a private reading aid: other people read the actor's attention, and a mark becomes something that can be answered rather than only added to
the layer competes with what it annotates; past some density the marks are what the reader sees, and pruning them is nobody's job by default

situation.initiating: pre-population has run out: the values that could be guessed from context or pulled from what the system already stores are in place, and what's left is work the actor would otherwise do themselves — which the system could take part of, if it were allowed to offer

resulting.clause: the loop is the system offering and the actor deciding, which makes dismissal the load-bearing half: an offer that can't be waved away cheaply stops being an offer
the more of the work the system takes on, the more trust the actor has to extend before accepting anything — so how an offer accounts for itself stops being decoration

the four sit at opposite ends of one spectrum and can't be tuned together: the offers a skilled actor barely notices and the offers that demand a deliberate judgement are the same move at incomparable stakes

situation.initiating: a compressed rendering — rows, cards, pins — carries a fixed subset of each entity's attributes, chosen once for everyone; the comparison the actor came to make is in the data, visible in the detail view, but absent from the view where comparing happens

resulting.clause: each view's attribute set is the actor's decision
the curation moves to the actor — surfaced sets drift and diverge, so the designed defaults still matter, now as a starting point rather than a ceiling
surfaced attributes become operable, changing what a view shows changes what the actor can do with it

situation.initiating: a free-form input where the set of valid answers is large or the actor is still formulating the query

resulting.clause: a narrowing surface of candidate completions running alongside what's been typed
autocomplete's candidates are looked up, not produced — deterministic completion ends where the continuation has to be generated; AI completion extends the same interaction to generated content

situation.initiating: the values the fields need are ones the system already holds — from the actor's profile, a prior session, the browser — so asking them to type what is already known is work with no purpose; and the confidence is high enough that filling won't be wrong

resulting.clause: the fields arrive already populated from the actor's own data, and what's left for them is checking rather than typing
filling a field silently shows the actor what the system knows about them, in a place they hadn't asked the question
pre-filled values get submitted without being read, so a wrong stored value travels further than a wrong typed one would have

situation.initiating: the content is neither prose nor a record but both by turns — parts of it want structure and parts want to stay loose, and the actor doesn't know at the outset which parts are which; a schema would demand that decision up front, and a plain writing surface would refuse to hold it at all

resulting.clause: each block carries only as much structure as currently serves it, gained or shed in place, so formalising is local and reversible instead of a commitment made before the work starts

the block is now the unit of everything the surface does — selecting, referencing, moving, commenting — so anything that addresses content addresses blocks, whether or not that matches how the actor thinks of what they wrote
every position in the document is a place where anything could go next, which puts the weight on saying *what* without having to say where

situation.initiating: a value the actor must supply from a set they didn't author and may not be able to survey

resulting.clause: a visible, narrowable candidate set that converges on a valid committed value

situation.initiating: the actor is about to ask for something and has no reliable read on what this agent can do; a conversational surface looks identical whether it can act, only retrieve, or only talk, so the boundary has to be stated rather than discovered by walking into it

resulting.clause: the actor knows what is in and out of scope before spending a turn on it, and an out-of-scope request meets a refusal with somewhere to go rather than a dead end
the statement is now a promise the rest of the exchange is held to; capability that turns out narrower than stated reads as the agent having misled them

situation.initiating: the goal that brought the actor here is met, or they have signalled they're done — the activity is finished but the encounter is still open, and cutting it off here forfeits whatever they hadn't got around to raising

resulting.clause: the encounter is ended deliberately: last topics were invited and either handled or scheduled, and both parties know it's over rather than parked
anything raised in the close and deferred is now an outstanding commitment the actor is expecting to be kept, outside this exchange

situation.initiating: a system recommendation is on the surface and accepting it costs less than evaluating it; the actor has the competence to judge and the stakes to warrant judging, but nothing in the interaction asks them to, so deferral accrues by default — and explanation alone won't fix it, since a plausible rationale can make rubber-stamping easier rather than harder

resulting.clause: the actor has had to do something — wait, commit an answer first, name a reason, finish an incomplete argument — before accepting, so the judgement on record is theirs; where that something was writing down why, the reasons accumulate into a trail somebody else can read
the friction is real and paid on every decision, so it holds only where the stakes keep justifying it; where they don't, actors learn the shortest path through it
the help lands unevenly — it works best on actors already inclined to think, and least on the ones most likely to defer, who are the reason for it

situation.initiating: several actors are working toward one outcome and each can only see their own part; with no shared account of what is happening they duplicate work, overwrite each other, and lose track of who owes what to whom

resulting.clause: work that was independent becomes joint: participants can see what others did, follow the reasoning behind it, and converge without needing to meet
agency is distributed and renegotiated turn by turn rather than held by anyone, so who decides is a live question at every step rather than a settled one
coordination now runs in a rhythm — synchronous or asynchronous — and that rhythm decides what kinds of disagreement can be resolved at all

situation.initiating: the actor knows what they want to do but not where its control lives; the capability has accumulated more commands than any toolbar or menu bar can hold, so hunting for one costs more than naming it would

resulting.clause: commands are reachable by name, which lifts the obligation on the chrome to display everything the surface can do; discovery moves from scanning to typing a guess

the menu shows only what applies here, so commands that don't apply are absent rather than visibly out of reach — which is a kindness for the irrelevant ones and a mystery for the ones the actor expected to find
naming needs the name: the move is fast for actors who already have the vocabulary and no help at all to actors who came looking for it

situation.initiating: the content is under review and the discussion about it belongs to particular places inside it rather than to the whole; a separate channel loses the anchor, and editing the content to raise the point destroys the thing being discussed

resulting.clause: discussion is anchored where it applies and stays out of the content itself, so the primary reading survives an active review
comments acquire a lifecycle of their own — open, answered, resolved — and something has to say when a thread is finished, or the layer only ever grows
the thread beside the content is a second place where decisions get made, and whatever was settled there is invisible to anyone reading only the content

situation.initiating: an evolving exchange between actors where meaning has to be built up over multiple turns rather than stated in one

resulting.clause: a dialogue structure that carries context forward, lets either party take a turn, and accommodates repair when alignment slips

situation.initiating: several views of one model already coexist — each earning its place by showing a different aspect — but relating them is the actor's job: find the item here, re-find it there, carry the correspondence in working memory

resulting.clause: designating something in one view marks it in every view where it appears; cross-view relationships — correlations invisible in any single view — arrive perceptually instead of being reconstructed
every added view charges for what the coupling buys, in learning time, working memory, screen space, and upkeep

each coupling is now a correctness surface: a false cue implies a relationship that doesn't hold, and propagation slower than ~100 ms reads as no relationship at all — the cues, not just the data, can lie

situation.initiating: the actor holds something the system needs — a date, a name, a measurement — in their own loose form, and guessing it isn't available because they are the only source; the system needs it structured and they expressed it however came naturally

resulting.clause: the expression is in and structured — and where the system did the structuring rather than the actor, its reading of what they meant has to be shown back before it counts as agreed
input that arrived cleanly can still be wrong in ways the control can't catch, so accepting a value and accepting it as correct are separate steps

the entry move is now spread across whatever surfaces host it — a form field, a conversational turn, a control in the inline interface — and the same value can arrive by any of them, in a different shape each time

situation.initiating: a collection too large or varied to absorb whole, and an actor whose purpose fixes what matters in it right now — which items, rendered how, ordered by what

resulting.clause: the collection reaches the actor already framed — queried, represented, arranged — and the framing is inspectable and adjustable rather than baked in
a framed population of items makes designating some of them for action cheap; what the framing exposes is what selection can operate on

situation.initiating: a state worth returning to takes several moves to reconstruct — a filtered view, an open item, a position in a space — and the only record of how to get back is in the actor's head; there is nothing to bookmark, send, or come back to

resulting.clause: any state worth naming has a name that restores it, so returning, sharing and bookmarking cost nothing beyond keeping the link
addressable state is state that has left the actor's control: a link travels, and whoever holds it reaches what it points at
the links are now a contract — states that were named have to keep resolving — which constrains how freely what sits behind them can be reorganised

situation.initiating: a stretch of activity in which the actor wants to remove data, with consequences that range from trivial to permanent and far-reaching

resulting.clause: a removal path matched to the severity, reversibility, and scope of the loss — confirmation, undo, soft delete, or typed challenge
the data is gone; whether that holds is now a question of recovery — a completed deletion is exactly the state undo acts on

situation.initiating: the exchange is mid-activity and one party has to step away — idle, interrupted, a dropped connection — with the goal still unmet; a formal close would misstate where things stand, and dropping it silently loses the work

resulting.clause: the exchange is parked rather than ended: state is saved, the actor can see what persists and for how long, and either side can pick it up again — the agent resuming, or the actor returning on their own initiative
parked state ages while nobody is watching it, so the assumptions inside it may not hold on return; confirming them is part of resuming, not an extra

situation.initiating: the item to operate on and the destination that stands for the outcome are both on screen, and asking for the operation by name — a menu, a form, a command — would restate what the actor can already point at

resulting.clause: the operation happens where its object and outcome are visible, and the result reads off the surface afterwards — the item sits where it was put, and the state is its own receipt
destinations are now part of the operation's vocabulary: each must mean exactly one thing, refuse what it cannot accept, and stay legible while a drag is in flight
every dragged operation exists twice — the gesture and its drag-free twin — and the pair must perform the identical write, or the interface holds two truths

situation.initiating: the corpus has grown past what anyone linked by hand; the explicit links are the connections somebody thought to make at the time of writing, and what the actor is after are the ones nobody did

resulting.clause: latent connections are on the surface as ranked suggestions, which lets the actor follow them without the system having claimed any of them are real structure
the suggested links are unfamiliar by construction — nobody authored them, so the actor has no prior expectation of where any one leads, and link text alone no longer tells them
the corpus holds more valid connections than anyone can read, so what the actor sees is whatever survived a ranking and a cutoff — and both are invisible to them

situation.initiating: the actor has a workflow they already know, and what would help sits inside it rather than beside it; a separate AI surface asks them to leave what they're doing, restate their context somewhere else, and carry the answer back by hand

resulting.clause: intelligence acts inside the existing workflow on context the system already holds, so the actor never restates what they're doing in order to get help with it
the system is now acting on inferred intent rather than stated intent, which means it will sometimes be confidently wrong about what the actor wanted
because the help is woven in, which part of the result was the actor's and which the system's stops being obvious — and that boundary only exists if something shows it

situation.initiating: the system did something the actor didn't expect or can't act on — a rule fired, an option isn't there, a recommendation arrived — and the reason for it lives inside the system rather than on the surface; left there, the actor either guesses at it or defers to the system wholesale

resulting.clause: the reasoning is legible, so the actor can judge when to trust the system and when to override it — which is a different capability from being able to operate it

a complete and plausible explanation can make deferring *easier* rather than harder: the actor now holds a justification they didn't have to think through, which is the state a forcing function exists to interrupt

an explanation pitched at the actor's level is a guess about that level — too much depth reads as noise, too little as evasion, and the actor can't ask for the difference unless the depth is theirs to move

situation.initiating: the actor needs content that won't fit one turn — instructions, an explanation, a narrative — and the single-turn forms have either been tried or are visibly too small for it; the agent has to hold the floor across several turns without losing them

resulting.clause: the telling runs as a structured sequence the actor controls: scope announced up front, each step advanced on their continuer, and skip, back and stop available throughout

holding the floor suppresses the actor's turn, so trouble that would have surfaced as an interruption now has to be invited — support moves at every step, and a visible way out of the telling into another activity

situation.initiating: a collection framing is in place and the actor's question concerns a subset of it — too many items to scan through, and they can say what distinguishes the ones they want

resulting.clause: the visible set is the actor's criteria made operative, and the criteria stay on the surface as chips or clauses so the actor can read what they are not being shown

an empty result is a dead end the actor reaches still holding their intent, and an over-full one means the criteria they have aren't the criteria the attributes can express — both are where narrowing stops being enough
everything is reachable in one place — which holds only while the tools and destinations fit one surface; when the item count outgrows the screen, hub and spoke takes over

situation.initiating: the actor is attending to one point inside something large — one event in a long record, one part of a deep structure — and needs it in full without losing the whole; a second view costs screen they don't have, and a scale control would take the surroundings away as it brought the point closer

resulting.clause: everything stays on screen, told unevenly: the focus in full, its surroundings coarser the further out they stand, and nothing moves as attention shifts

the actor steers the lens but the system decides what counts as near, so the distance metric — position along a sequence, steps through a structure, a model's confidence — is doing editorial work under the appearance of geometry
the coarse rungs are summaries something has to produce, and at the rim they may be generated; generated text then sits in a place the actor reads as structure

situation.initiating: a stretch of activity in which the system needs structured information from the actor that can't be inferred from prior context

resulting.clause: a guided collection surface where fields are committed one at a time and the whole set can be reviewed before submission
every destination is one move from every other, and the shape of the whole is visible from anywhere — bought with screen space on every page, spent whether or not the actor on that page needs it

the global menu is a fixed budget that content growth eats into; the set that has to fit the chrome stops fitting long before the content stops arriving, and what gives is either the depth on show or the topology

situation.initiating: the system has produced something substantial — prose, a draft, a chart, code — and the actor's job has shifted from making it to judging it; accepting it whole costs nothing and checking it costs whatever the thing is long

resulting.clause: the output is material the actor negotiates rather than an artefact they receive: rate it, edit it, regenerate part of it, take the half that works
the actor owns the result without having made it, so what they can find out about where it came from decides whether they can stand behind it
verification cost rises with length, and long output is exactly where accepting quietly takes the place of checking
fields hold the system's best static guess — which serves only until the actor starts typing a value of their own; completion then has to happen in flight rather than up front
a good default is a guess made without the actor's stored data; where the system already holds the actual value, pre-filling from the record takes over from guessing
pre-population ends where the task needs the system to participate in the work itself — the assisted-completion spectrum picks up where a static guess stops sufficing

situation.initiating: the collection is flat and the actor's question is about subsets rather than items — which cluster is largest, which is behind, how two of them compare — and a flat list gives them nothing to compare

resulting.clause: the collection has visible structure along a chosen attribute, so differences between subsets are readable without the actor tallying anything by hand
the grouping attribute is a claim about which of an item's attributes matters most, and an item that genuinely belongs in two groups has to be filed in one
headers cost space and carry collapse state, so a grouping that yields many small groups fragments the list it was meant to organise

situation.initiating: the actor has hit friction they can't resolve from the surface — they don't know where they are, what a term means, or how to do the thing — and the answer exists somewhere other than where they are looking; they came to it, which is what separates this from the system offering

resulting.clause: the answer arrives at the point of friction and in context, so learning happens when the actor needs it rather than ahead of time
the channel is pull-based: it reaches the actors who thought to ask, and says nothing to the ones who didn't know there was something to ask about
the content is a second telling of the system that has to be kept true as the system changes, or it goes on teaching the old one

every destination is two moves from every other through a surface that always knows the way, so the actor can't get lost — and can't travel laterally either; a journey between two spokes that turns out to be routine is paid for twice on every trip

the hub is the one surface every journey passes through, which makes it the natural place to report across all the spokes — what changed, what needs attention; what to show there is its own design problem, not something the topology settles
a spoke has little room for navigation of its own, so anything that has to be reachable from inside one competes for space with the spoke's actual work

situation.initiating: the actor's own competence is the thing the system was meant to support, and always seeing the recommendation first is quietly eroding it; the other forcing functions interrupt a single decision, and what's at stake here is the skill across all of them — which only survives if it is occasionally used unaided

resulting.clause: the actor has an unaided answer on record before they see the system's, so the comparison teaches whichever way the mismatch runs — including the way that confirms they were right
the value sits in the comparison, not the withholding: a bare "you said X, the system said Y" charges the actor for unaided work and returns nothing for it
withholding is expensive enough that it can only run some of the time, which makes how often a live decision rather than a settled one — and one the actor has a stake in
the second commitment happened where the first one did, so the actor was interrupted without being relocated — one decision of friction rather than a change of place

an armed control is a state the interface has to manage: it reverts on its own after a moment, and it has to look different enough from resting that the actor can tell a loaded control from an idle one
confirming is not reversing — the actor consented before the act and has nothing to undo after it, so anything that might still need taking back needs its own route

situation.initiating: the exchange has reached a point where words are the wrong vehicle — the actor needs to pick from a set, confirm one specific thing, nudge a value, read a chart — and putting it in prose asks them to do the rendering in their head

resulting.clause: the message is a thing to act on rather than words to read, so dialogue and application share one surface and the actor never leaves the conversation to do the work
interface rendered into a stream inherits the stream's properties: it scrolls away, it persists in the history, and a control the actor left untouched several turns ago is still sitting there live
what the actor did inline has to read afterwards as a decision rather than as a widget left in a state — the transcript is now a record of actions as well as words

situation.initiating: an activity is under way and the agent is missing something it can't infer — a required value, a constraint, a choice between candidates it can't rank — so the work stops until the actor supplies it

resulting.clause: the missing value is captured and confirmed, and the activity resumes at the step that needed it

the actor has been asked directly, which sets the expectation that the agent only asks for what it genuinely lacks; anything it could have inferred or defaulted now reads as busywork when it asks again

situation.initiating: the exchange is open and the actor has a question the agent can answer as asked — nothing to disambiguate first, no multi-step work behind it

resulting.clause: the question is answered and the pair is complete; the actor is between activities rather than inside one, free to follow up, check the source, or start something else
a direct answer carries no working, so for anything non-trivial the actor is taking the agent's word for it unless evidence came with the answer

situation.initiating: an entity must appear somewhere — inside running text, among its peers, on its own — and the moment fixes how much of it the actor needs: bare recognition, quick comparison, or a full working surface

resulting.clause: the entity renders at the level of detail its moment needs and remains recognisable as the same entity at every level
moving between levels is a designed transition, not a page reload — context survives the shift in depth

situation.initiating: the actor already knows what they want and has done it often enough for it to be motor memory; the interface path they would otherwise take is now the slowest part of the operation

resulting.clause: intent goes straight to execution without traversing the interface — for the actors who have the vocabulary
the vocabulary is invisible by construction, so knowing that shortcuts exist and using them stay separate events, and the gap between them has to be closed somewhere the actor is already looking
the set is a fixed budget: every binding added dilutes what can be internalised, and the platform conventions are already spent

situation.initiating: the content is densely cross-referenced and every link is a fork in the actor's attention; finding out whether a link was worth following costs the reading position, so the actor either clicks indiscriminately or stops clicking

resulting.clause: the actor can sample a destination without leaving their place, so triage happens at the link rather than after the navigation — follow it, skip it, or note it for later

the page now owes the actor a ladder of commitment rather than one click: peek, open alongside, open fully — and each rung has to be reachable by keyboard as well as by hover, since hover is the one channel touch doesn't have
once the stream completes, a produced artifact sits on the surface — the move shifts from holding the rendering stable to negotiating what arrived

situation.initiating: the artefact was accurate when it was written and its context has since moved; keeping it current by hand is work nobody schedules, so it quietly becomes wrong while still being read as current

resulting.clause: the artefact moves with its context, so what a reader finds reflects now rather than whenever it was last touched by a person
something is doing work on the document without being asked, and that work has a cost that has to stay visible or it runs unbudgeted
the document no longer has one author: the reader can't tell what was written, what was regenerated, and what changed since they last read it

situation.initiating: the actor is past learning the tool and is in it daily; the scaffolding that got them started is now in the way, and what caps them is the interface rather than their understanding of the work

resulting.clause: there are optional routes to expertise that nobody has to take, so the perpetual intermediates stay productive while the few who want depth can find it
the expert reshapes the tool around their own way of working, which means the tool has to have parts that move
a surface tuned for mastery is denser than a beginner can read, so one product has to serve both without splitting into two
content sits at addresses the actor can learn and re-find, and the trail from the root to here is available as orientation without spending extra chrome on it
the hierarchy is now a standing guess about how the actor categorises, and it will be wrong for some content and some actors; a thing that belongs in two places has to be filed in one
lateral movement costs a trip back up: two sections that turn out to be related have no path between them that the structure recognises

situation.initiating: the actor is at a transition point in a workflow the system can read — it knows what they just finished and holds enough signal to name a plausible next step — and what's worth proposing is a whole action rather than a value, so nothing further down the completion spectrum reaches it

resulting.clause: the system proposes actions rather than values, so accepting one commits the actor to something whose consequences they didn't work out themselves; what guards the accept has to be proportional to what the action does
where the stakes are high, the recommendation being easy to accept is the problem rather than the feature — the accept needs a beat of deliberate thought built into it
recommendations now arrive uninvited, at moments the system picked; a pile of them nobody resolved teaches the actor to stop reading the channel at all

situation.initiating: a system event whose existence the actor needs to know about, alongside an existing flow that has its own demands on attention

resulting.clause: a delivery surface tuned to the event's urgency and the actor's availability

situation.initiating: an actor's first encounter with a system (or a changed part of one) before they have a working mental model of what's possible and what will happen

resulting.clause: a bounded period in which the actor can build that model with low stakes, often by doing rather than reading

situation.initiating: the actor has stated a goal rather than a step — complex enough that the agent can't act on it as given, with constraints missing and several moves between the request and the outcome

resulting.clause: the request is framed rather than merely received: goal, constraints, assumptions and sources are explicit, and what's still missing shows up as named gaps instead of general vagueness
a plan exists and the agent is about to act on the actor's behalf; where a step can't be taken back, the actor's explicit go-ahead has to come before it, not after

situation.initiating: the decision has failure modes somebody can name in advance, and the actor accepting output isn't failing to think so much as failing to think about the right things; a delay would buy them time without telling them where to spend it

resulting.clause: the review is structured rather than gestalt — the actor has engaged with each named consideration before the accept became available to them
a required checklist creates compliance pressure, so each item either points somewhere the actor wouldn't have looked or it becomes a box to clear
the enumerated failure modes are now a standing artefact with an owner: the domain's failure modes move, and a checklist that doesn't move with them certifies the wrong things

situation.initiating: a collection framing exists and the actor works item by item — scanning many candidates, verifying one — but no single view is both compact enough to scan and rich enough to verify

resulting.clause: two linked views cover one collection — one compressed, one in full — and the actor moves between them without losing their place
the overview's attribute subset fixes what the actor can compare, sort, and filter by — a ceiling only malleability lifts

everything keeps its place in one coordinate system, so nothing breaks the spatial sense — and orientation becomes the actor's problem: at any zoom the view carries no evidence of where it sits in the whole, which is what a second, wider viewport kept in step is for
a continuous space has no addresses of its own; position and scale have to be made nameable before anything in it can be linked to, bookmarked, or returned to
what's on screen is a fraction of what exists, so the space has to decide what to load and what detail to draw at each scale — and those are visible to the actor as waiting, not as engineering

situation.initiating: a purpose recurs so predictably that the domain can state, by consensus and in advance, what counts as a problem — yet on every visit the actor still triages a general view by inference, re-deriving the same judgements the rules could carry

resulting.clause: what needs attention arrives as a rule-backed checklist — index, navigation, status display and audit trail at once — and every flag can say why it fired
